Description

Light-colored recycled rubber anti-slip mats in 200×250mm format. The mixed color appearance means no dark marks are left on cargo — ideal for concrete blocks, plaster, paper rolls, timber and other light-colored goods.

Individual mat format is easy to place between cargo layers and on pallet bases. High friction coefficient of >0.6μ prevents load shifting during road and sea transport. 100% reusable and weatherproof.

Delivery

In stock and ready to ship. EU delivery within 2–4 business days. Worldwide freight available on request — contact us at info@sorbpack.com for a quote.
